name: trialbox-browser-tests
description: The browser test tools TrialBox's walks use (DEP-025, D-393). Not installed on the box. Playwright drives the walks (tools/public_walk.js, tests/e2e); axe-core is vendored as tools/vendor/axe.min.js, and this lock records the release it came from. tests/unit/test_browser_lock.py keeps this file, the vendored file's sha256 and the CI and complete-run Playwright versions equal.
